# Text to Speech

Text to speech: turn a script into natural voice-overs and narration in many voices and languages, generated as audio files for videos, ads, podcasts and audiobooks.

## What it does
Paste or write the script, pick a voice (or let Claude suggest one), and get an audio file. The price depends on the length of the script and is shown first.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Up to 5,000 characters per run; longer scripts can be split into parts.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install text-to-speech@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/voiceover/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_voiceover_models` | Models for voice-overs with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_voiceover_cost` | Exact price of one voice-over before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_voiceover` | Starts one voice-over in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_voiceover` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Read this product description in a calm female voice"
- "A 30-second ad voice-over, energetic, American English"
- "Narrate the first chapter of my story in a deep male voice"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
